words
  Biyani Girls College is currently having the following mechanisms for effective
delivery of curriculum: • At the beginning of an academic session, an IQAC
meeting is held for successful planning and implementation of the curriculum. •
The departmental meetings are also held in each department for the discussion
and implementation of revised and updated syllabi of each class of UG and PG. •
All the subject teachers are instructed to prepare the teaching plan and submit
it to the HOD of the concerned department. • Well-structured time table of each
class of UG and PG are designed for successful completion of the syllabus on
time. • The college

 2.5.2 – Reforms initiated on Continuous Internal Evaluation(CIE) system at the institutional level (250 words)
  Biyani Girls College, Jaipur has a firm belief in continuous evaluation of the
students for their sustainable performance. Hence, a structured evaluation
process has been designed and implemented. We organize several class tests,
internal examinations, pre-university exams, and practical exams as per the
university guidelines and pattern. The institute ensures that the students

nd implemented. We organize several class tests,
internal examinations, pre-university exams, and practical exams as per the
university guidelines and pattern. The institute ensures that the students are
well prepared for these exams thus objectives and subjective tests are prepared
before the commencements of the session. The core examination committee and a
team of exam coordinators from each department schedule and execute different
examinations. Internal flying squad of the senior faculty members and CCTV
cameras are deployed in all the classrooms, exam cell, and laboratory for
strict monitoring of exams. Results of each exam are declared within a week of
the completion of the exam. Students can see their answers sheets and discuss
queries with concerning faculty members. Following are the evaluation reforms
initiated on the continuous internal evaluation (CIE) system 1. Regular class
tests are conducted and their records are maintained. 2. Internal examinations
are conducted twice

tests are conducted and their records are maintained. 2. Internal examinations
are conducted twice a year. 3. Pre-university exams are conducted before the
commencement of final university exams. 4. Mock practical and viva-voce are
also conducted on regular basis.

monitoring of exam. Results of each exam are declared within a week of the

The admission process is conducted through online/offline mode. This course is recognized by the Council and affiliated with Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Rajasthan Ayurved University (DSRRAU), Jodhpur. Admission is based on the merit of marks obtained in Class 12th (any stream), with no entrance exam required.By completing this course from Biyani Institute of Ayush Nursing, students become well-qualified for diverse career opportunities in both the private and government sectors. They can secure positions in hospitals, nursing homes, orphanages, old age homes, industries, sanatoriums, and the armed forces. Additionally, they may find rewarding roles with organizations such as the Indian Red Cross Society, Indian Nursing Council, State Nursing Councils, and various reputed nursing institutions. Our vision at BISD is to create fashion professionals equipped with sound knowledge, diversified skills, and ethical practices. Responsible Fashion is our ethos, and we ensure an enriching experience for our students through audio-visual classroom teaching, activity-based learning with cutting-edge technology, and hands-on exposure to industry and crafts. We emphasize the development of diverse skills supported by digital media and promote green and responsible fashion practices at every stage. As fashion designers, our students can pursue various profiles such as merchandiser, designer, illustrator, and even establish their own brands. In our Journalism and Mass Communication Department, we prepare students for all media platforms. Our program is tailored to meet the evolving needs of the media industry, combining formal lectures, seminars, computer-based learning, and individual/group projects. We focus on nurturing socially responsible media professionals, supported by industry insights, experienced faculty, and state-of-the-art infrastructure. The Biyani Nursing College is running under biyani shikshan Samiti and it is a part of Biyani Group of Colleges. it is offering two nursing courses Diploma and Undergraduate courses only for female students. The college was founded in 2006 and is approved by the Indian Nursing council, Rajasthan University of Health Sciences and Rajasthan Nursing Council.Biyani Nursing college is committed to create high quality nursing professionals through nursing education and practice. The College has a pool of qualified and experienced faculty in all branches of nursing. The faculty members are dedicated in providing personalized guidance and mentorship, ensuring students receive the best theoretical and practical knowledge. Alumni NAAC Blogs Biyani Library Contact Us National Service Scheme (NSS) National Service Scheme (NSS) is an integral part of Biyani activities. NSS has allotted 2 units to Biyani Group of Colleges, one for Biyani Girls College and other for Biyani Law College. The colleges conduct NSS activities throughout the year to inculcate the spirit of social services among the students. A number of activities were conducted in the year 2018-19 such as participating in Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Tree Plantation, Blood Donation Camp, Independence and Republic Day celebration, Sports activities, Adventure Camps, Nukkad Natak for social awareness, State level competition, etc. Few of these activities as listed as under Road Safety Awareness Month A road safety awareness program was organized by the NSS units of Biyani Girls College. its of Biyani Girls College. The program began with an address by Dr. Rajiv Biyani, Director of Biyani Group of Colleges, who spoke about the importance of following traffic rules. Sakura Science Exchange Programme The Sakura Science Exchange Program, organized by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST), provided a 15-day immersive academic and cultural experience for our science delegation at Kwansei Gakuin University in July 2025. An anti-ragging squad is in operation under the overall charge of the dean. Students are advised to bring cases of ragging (either on the college campus or hostel) to the notice of the dean or deputy director student’s affair or the teacher guardians or respective hostel wardens. The offenders shall be liable for punishment with imprisonment up to 3-years. Offenders may be expelled from the institution. Administrative action in the event of ragging:Anyone found guilty of ragging and/or abetting ragging, whether actively or passively or being a part of a conspiracy to promote ragging, is liable to be punished in accordance with these regulations as well as under the provisions of any penal law for the time being in force. as under the provisions of any penal law for the time being in force. B.
